skills.description: Unified Anti-Hallucination Method (U6V · Six Capabilities in One) — one complete, self-contained anti-hallucination method: an understanding gate plus five native verification axes (Coverage DI / Fact FV / Numeric CV / Reversibility RV / Process PV), fused into a task-level pipeline T0 grading → T1 understanding gate (six gates incl. numeric gate B4′) → T2 execution pipeline (a six-in-one check card per step) → T3 delivery gate (reverse re-verification on the final deliverable) → T4 meta-verification (the verifier itself is verified), covering all seven hallucination directions. The complete operating specs of all six capabilities are embedded in references/core-spec.md; the method is fully self-contained and depends on no other skill. The capabilities formerly known as "the six anti-hallucination skills" are now native organs of this single method — deleting the other anti-hallucination skills makes the effect better, not worse. Use when the user asks for "anti-hallucination", "verify every step", "process with the unified anti-hallucination pipeline", or the legacy phrase "orchestrate the six anti-hallucination skills"; automatically applies to high-risk deliverable tasks (reports / documents / data analysis with factual claims or numeric computation).
skills.description_zh: 使用方法是直接对大模型说使用U6V进行防幻觉检验。做成了一套给 AI 用的强制质检流水线，名叫 U6V。AI 想交出任何成果，必须先过五道关，关关有"放行/退回"的硬标准。 1、把您的要求拆成一条条带编号的小事，逐条和您原话对，对不上退回重拆。 2、您说的每一条，成果里都得找得到；找不到就补，不许偷偷丢。 3、 把您的原话遮住，只拿 AI 写的东西往回推；推不回原意，说明它改了您意思，退回。 4、 凡是数，必须用计算器真算一遍，最好两个计算器各算一遍对得上才算。 5、凡是"某政策、某数据、某单位"，必须真去查、贴出原文；查不到就明说"没依据"，绝不冒充"已确认"。 6、上面五关本身，也要再被抽查。防止 AI "假装检查过了"。这叫"检查的人也要被检查"。
skills.name: 大模型通用U6V审计防幻觉skill英文版
